finalText:
**Migrated 36 `db.query` calls across 12 files.** All now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

`node --check` passes on every file. No `db.query` left outside vendor.

I left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone. It has 2 calls. Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it.

`cache.query` is a separate API. I did not touch it.
